mapper.select: SELECT t1.id, t1.title, t1.content, t1.type, t2.nickname AS publisherName, t1.level, t1.publish_status, t1.publish_time FROM sys_notice t1 LEFT JOIN sys_user t2 ON t2.id = t1.publisher_id WHERE t1.id = #{id} AND t1.is_deleted = 0

SELECT n.id, n.title, n.content, n.type, u.nickname AS publisherName, n.level, n.publish_status, n.publish_time FROM sys_notice n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = n.publisher_id WHERE n.id = #{id} AND n.is_deleted = 0 AND n.publish_status = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_notice un WHERE un.notice_id = n.id AND un.user_id = #{userId} AND un.is_deleted = 0 )
